title: Scan the Tin You Cannot Identify
description: Go to the cupboard, find the tin or jar you do not remember buying, and scan its barcode.

title: Cook for One More Person
description: Make enough for someone who was not expecting it, then hand them a plate.

title: Write Down the Recipe You Never Wrote Down
description: The one you cook from memory. Amounts, order, and the bit you always get wrong.

rubric.ideal: It names the ingredients with real amounts: two tins of tomatoes, two onions, a whole head of garlic, a big pinch of salt, enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan.
It gives the steps in the order you actually do them: soften the onions first, add the garlic once they turn translucent, then the tomatoes, then simmer for forty minutes until it goes dark.
It admits the part that goes wrong: I always put the garlic in too early and burn it, so wait until the onions have gone soft and sweet.
